meta.note: Items marked verified:true are 100% locked from v0.9941 in-game screenshots. Items marked verified:false are ready to be updated directly from in-game screenshots without changing any app code.

recommendation_rules.single_focus_threshold: If 1 fusion is pinned OR >=2 pinned fusions share the same Main Magic, rank the matching specialist class #1.
recommendation_rules.multi_fusion_rule: If 2–3 pinned fusions have distinct Main Magics, rank Archmage / Archaeologist / Scholar as top universal picks alongside the highest-ranked Main Magic specialist.
recommendation_rules.scaling_overlap_bonus: Boost subject & class score when their functional tags match the pinned build's dominant scaling tags (e.g., cdr_scaling, size_scaling, duration_scaling, crit_scaling).

classes.name: Archmage
mastery_bonuses: Magic Circle Lv +1
Silent Casting Lv +1
Increase Combination Magic Damage by 50%
Decrease All Magic Cooldown by 3% (All Classes)
classes.recommended_when: Best all-around pick when running 2–3 different Main Magics; accelerates early Lv.25/50/75 spikes and scales every Combination Magic.

classes.name: Archaeologist
base_bonuses: Artifact progression and item selection scaling
mastery_bonuses: Additional Treasure Chest spawn chance
Artifact inventory synergy and EXP gain scaling
classes.recommended_when: Top late-game meta class for long runs (45m+) where extra Legendary/Special Artifacts and Artifact Synergies outweigh single-spell bonuses.

classes.name: Scholar
base_bonuses: Faster leveling and increased EXP gain
mastery_bonuses: Additional Mana and EXP acquisition rate
Greater magic selection consistency
classes.recommended_when: Great for reliably hitting Lv.75/100 and assembling strict multi-fusion recipes with minimal RNG.

classes.name: Black Mage
base_bonuses: Corpse Explosion triggers on enemy defeat
Dark Magic execution and damage scaling
mastery_bonuses: Increases Corpse Explosion trigger rate and blast radius
Boosts Dark Magic damage and execution threshold
classes.recommended_when: Strong universal crowd-clear amplifier for dense late-game swarms.

classes.name: Arcanist

classes.name: Dark Wizard
